project_name: Google Council Bluffs data center campus
status_detail: Google says it has operated in Iowa since 2007, beginning with its Council Bluffs data center, and has made multiple expansions in Council Bluffs.
notes: Official Google location page confirms Council Bluffs as the original Iowa data center hub and lists milestones for 2007, 2012, 2015, 2024, and 2025. County official site checked via Pottawattamie/Council Bluffs planning sources; project is inside Council Bluffs.

status_detail: Google announced a 2025 Iowa investment that includes expansion of its existing Council Bluffs facility along with a new Cedar Rapids campus.
notes: Google official sources describe expansion of the existing Council Bluffs facility but do not break out MW capacity or construction phase for the Council Bluffs portion.

status_detail: CyrusOne lists OCB1 as a 216,000 sq ft Council Bluffs data center with 120,000 sq ft of raised floor/white space; company press release said the site would have 24 MW total power available on completion.
notes: CyrusOne official facility page confirms active facility; 24 MW comes from the company's 2019 groundbreaking press release.

status_detail: Tracker source lists CyrusOne Council Bluffs II as under construction with 180 MW in Pottawattamie County.
notes: Included for completeness because county-level tracker separates a second CyrusOne Council Bluffs project. CyrusOne official public page found only OCB1, so treat the II/capacity details as tracker-grade until confirmed by permits or company filings.

status_detail: Local meeting-summary reporting says UR Energy presented a proposed small closed-loop/tier-zero data center to the Poweshiek County Board of Supervisors on May 14, 2026, with 3-5 expected jobs.
notes: County Board of Supervisors page was checked for original agenda/minutes access; search surfaced no county-hosted minute text with the UR Energy details. Keep as planned/news-grade pending original minutes.

status_detail: Official county ordinances page lists a Data Center Moratorium Ordinance; local sources describe a 12-month moratorium process for new data centers in unincorporated Ringgold County, but no named developer/project was found.
notes: Moratorium noted for coverage. Search did not identify a site, applicant, developer, tax abatement, rezoning, or permit for an actual Ringgold County data center project.

status_detail: Sac County adopted and later extended a temporary moratorium on conditional use permits for digital asset mining/data centers, now through December 31, 2026; no named project was found.
notes: Official county records mention digital asset mining/data centers as a permit category under moratorium, not a specific project. Search did not find applicant, location, MW, or developer.

project_name: Vemerald / Meta Davenport data center campus
status_detail: Davenport city agenda materials and IEDA/news reports describe a Vemerald LLC high-tech data center: about 328 acres near Hillandale Road and Enterprise Way, at least two data halls and ancillary buildings totaling about 715,000 sq ft, minimum $800M investment, and property tax exemption support.
notes: DCD reported IEDA later identified Meta as the company behind Vemerald. 2026 local reporting says land remains empty/no ground broken, so status is approved rather than construction.

status_detail: Shelby County agenda records show consideration of Resolution No. 2026-16, a moratorium on asset mining/data center permits; no specific Iowa project was found.
notes: Search results contain many false positives for Shelby County, Indiana/Alabama and social posts. For Shelby County, Iowa, found moratorium evidence but not an applicant, site, or named project.

aliases: PathOne Data Centers Sioux County project
status_detail: County official notice announced an August 10, 2026 community information meeting hosted by PathOne Data Centers; KTIV reported developers proposed a 30,000-50,000 sq ft facility on the old Bison Plant property about two miles southwest of Hull, with an end user lined up before the county moratorium.
notes: Official county page confirms PathOne public meeting and topic list. Detailed site/developer facts come from KTIV/Sioux County Radio; power, water, and energy specifics were reported as unresolved.

status_detail: City of Ames materials say Lightedge requested negotiations for a new colocation data center on about 10.86 acres along Aviation Way at the Ames Municipal Airport, with a roughly 100,000 sq ft facility built out in phases over an estimated 10 years.
notes: Ames staff report gives initial phase up to 3 MW and second phase 6 MW but does not state final total MW; the proposal remained under City Council review/listening sessions as of July 2026.

status_detail: Tama County zoning page lists a Moratorium on Data Mining and Data Centers, Resolution 11-10-2025A, and minutes direct the Zoning Commission to develop a comprehensive data center ordinance; no specific data center project was found.
notes: Official county records show regulation/moratorium activity only. Search did not identify a developer, permit, rezoning, tax abatement, or project site.

status_detail: Taylor County official notices say Ordinance No. 40 established a temporary 12-month moratorium on new applications for data centers, solar energy systems, battery energy storage systems, and mineral rights developments; no named data center project was found.
notes: Official county notice confirms moratorium. Search did not find an applicant, location, capacity, permit, or tax abatement for a Taylor County data center project.
